feature: Optional body and four-paw orientation targets for generated Rigify quadrupeds

acceptance.position: Every enabled body/paw position residual remains within the established scale-aware 0.28 tolerance
acceptance.orientation: Every enabled native torso/paw IK control reaches its helper world rotation within 2e-5 radians
acceptance.workflow: Keep captures one editable anchor and restores source action, slot, transforms and IK modes; Cancel restores without an anchor
acceptance.recovery: Solved position and orientation targets survive save/reload and can be kept
acceptance.guards: Rotation locks, active constraints and rotation drivers fail before mutation when orientation is enabled
acceptance.isolation: Humanoid and other preview owners retain their existing behavior

qualified: Generated Rigify cat, horse and wolf recognition
Generic pose capture and Pose Blending on generated fixtures
Deterministic body and four-paw position targets through existing native IK
Optional body and four-paw IK-control orientation targets
Source restoration, editable anchor capture and save/reload recovery
Fail-closed rotation locks, constraints and drivers
not_qualified: Quadruped learned posing or learned motion
Quadruped gait, balance, contact or flight physics
Pole direction, automatic paw planting or detailed spine/head shaping
Direct metarig, imported or custom quadruped posing
